errors.description: Carried forward from attempt 1 and still not resolvable: at 12x magnification the drawing's placket column shows marks at six heights - four upper positions each carrying a paired left-and-right mark, and two lower positions with a single mark only. That could read as four stud positions above two ordinary buttons (the standard dinner-shirt arrangement, which would also explain the option name). The photograph shows exactly two studs, which is what the locked prompt's COUNT LOCK requires and what the catalog label '(2 Buttons)' states. I did not verify which reading of the drawing is correct and I am not asserting one; the render follows the locked specification. Flagged for a human to adjudicate against the supplier tech pack at full resolution.
